summary: This memo analyzes the X.25 packet-network interface and points out problems in its conceptual model, especially the clash between its interface role and end-to-end service. It also touches on security and implementation issues. Originally a MITRE Corporation report, it is a critique, not a specification.

eli5.summary: Someone looks at a mail-sorting system and shows where its rules do not fit together well, like a mailbox that also tries to deliver the letter itself.
